title: Terms of the Settlement Discount Where the Building Also Holds Maintenance Cover
content:
# Terms of the Settlement Discount Where the Building Also Holds Maintenance Cover

**Term 1.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier covers repair labor, the sum required to settle the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans is taken at a settlement discount of four per cent.

**Term 2.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier does not cover repair labor, the sum required is taken at a settlement discount of two per cent.

**Term 3.** In every other case no settlement discount is taken.

The agreement, its standing and whether its tier covers repair labor are read from the office's records of Preventive Maintenance Agreements written against that building.

| Maintenance agreement at the building standing active | That agreement's tier covers repair labor | Settlement discount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 4 per cent |
| yes | no | 2 per cent |
| no | not read | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A sum standing at 5000.00 USD before the discount, at a building carrying an agreement under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing active whose tier covers repair labor, is taken at 4 per cent off, that is 4800.00 USD. Where that agreement's tier does not cover repair labor, the discount is 2 per cent and the sum is 4900.00 USD. Where no agreement stands active at the building, the sum stays at 5000.00 USD.
